title: Documentary
subtitle: The type 135 negative has appeared wherever conflict happens, from snow covered peaks to deep forests, and the wilderness within the soul.

trails.title: Trail ① The Secret Business
trails.description: A few old tales and some more old rumors. Ask around, you'll know what it's all about.

content.text: Excerpt from the New York Times

Around midnight two days ago, a large fire broke out in the oak forest on the western outskirts. The delay of the warning and the complex terrains full of inflammables in the forest resulted in a fire that lasted a whole night till dawn and 13 deaths.
The victims entered the forest at dusk. Identities of 6 of them have been confirmed: the Weyerhaeusers, their buyers Tomson Joyce, Shelley Gerald, Kelly Keith, and the project manager Russell James. The others' are still being verified.

The Weyerhaeuser used to be a leader in the wood industry, yet it went bankrupt not long ago due to the wood supply crisis these years. After donating the formula of the Resurrection Potion (basic version) to the Maria Sanatorium in New York, the Sacred Heart Sanatorium in Ohio, and the Presbyterian Church Health Center on certain conditions, the Weyerhaeusers sold all of their forestry lands.
On the night of the fire, the Weyerhaeusers, their buyers, and the workers went into the forest to start the disafforestation project before they died. The police has found traces of arcanist's activities and a small amount of gasoline at the scene, which shows the case is an arson attack. More investigations are needed to identify the suspect.

Reporter: James Welles/Dorey Johnson

trails.title: Trail ② Enemy at the Corner Ⅱ
trails.description: An unexpected Manus squad. You should be careful as usual.

items.text: Documentary

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Why ... why can't the fog be cleared? ... How can we get in?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I've already heard the Timekeeper's voice. She is close to us. She needs help!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: The arcane skill on the fog is far more powerful than ours. It's countering us.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I can't wait any longer. I don't want it to be ... like the last time ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: There must be a way to focus all of our arcanum simultaneously.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: As long as we're more powerful, even just for a second! ... As long as there's a breach ...
Sometimes, things can be fixed without arcanum.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Huh ...!

items.speaker: X
items.text: It is also a good way ... to learn from human experience.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Mr. X, and ... Regulus!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: So the reinforcements sent by the Foundation are you guys. Excellent!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Phew! Finally we catch up. I'm cream crackered!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No worries, Sonetto! We will rush in and meet Vertin!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What did you just say, Mr. X? Is there another way?

items.speaker: X
items.text: The essence of arcane power ... lies in the intuitive insight into everything.

items.speaker: X
items.text: And our human friends are good at logical deduction based on awareness, which is rejected by the arcanists.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Since we can't beat the Manus in terms of arcanum, then ...

items.speaker: X
items.text: He knocks at the weird-shaped pipe hiding under his coat.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Why not try to use a counter-intuitive logic experiment to open the door of this protective incantation?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Anyway, as long as the caster can be interrupted, anything is fine.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Hmm, are you going to avoid the surveillance of the fog, and go directly in to break the incantation?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What counter-intuitive experiment will you do?

items.speaker: X
items.text: Heh heh, check it out.

items.speaker: X
items.text: The next experiment is: within three minutes, use this copper pipe to boil a pot of water in the distance!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: A Goldberg Machine! That explains it. Now I understand!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: How did you get it? Uhh, I think people at the Foundation are more or less freaks.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: But well, the kind of machine designed to be meaningless at every step is indeed counter-intuitive.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Maybe it really will release us from the control of arcanum. Haha! It's a gas!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: So, please start the experiment soon! We do not have much time.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Please hold on, Timekeeper. Reinforcements are coming right away.
Clinic, Scorched Woods

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: There are so many of us. How many rounds can you make it through?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Your good luck won't last long.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Despite the coming "Storm," or the Foundation's reinforcements, there is only one ending to your story.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Ha ha! I don't care about the words of a dying man.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Miss Druvis, I've found the truth for you.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: The culprit to blame, the arsonist, is right here in the shelter.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: As long as you keep your promise to stay.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: No ... It's not important anymore ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Not important?! He ruined everything with just 20 barrels of gasoline!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: That's him. Do you know who he is?

items.speaker: Tramp
items.text: Arrgh ... Uggh ...

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: A firefighter who lost his job because of the depression! Thought that putting out a fire could win him his job back!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Look at those hands, they set the fire, burned your families alive, burned your woods into ashes!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: How could you ... how could you even forget such pain like that? Druvis!

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Thank you, Mr. Forget Me Not.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: For your help in the flames in the past. For your compassion for someone you've never met.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Today is just the same as before. In the past, I tried everything to protect something.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: But before I knew it, I already stood on the opposite side of myself in the past.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: My woods will not perish.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: They will live with scars, and new shoots in spring.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: They will look haggard, but at the same time they will stand upright.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: They will continue to grow, recording everything about their own history, territory, residents, and an anecdote of a reckless firefighter in the 1920s.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: They will keep growing upwards, until they cross the millennium.

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: Huh ... please allow me to bid you farewell, Mr. Forget Me Not.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: I don't understand ... I can't understand ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We belong to the future, Forget Me Not.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's raining.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What comes after the rain, is a bottle of boiled water pouring down on him.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: But he stands still.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: ... It's still February. But for you, isn't the spring already here?

items.speaker: Druvis Ⅲ
items.text: I think I should go back to where I belong.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Flowers. More flowers. Without being noticed, they are sprouting on the scorched earth and become flower fields.

items.speaker: Journalist
items.text: The forget-me-not flower field?! I wrote about the place ... in Rainier ... Urrgh!!!

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: That journalist falls down in a puddle of her own blood.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Footsteps are getting closer. The incantation has dispelled, and people who dispelled it are running towards here.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: These seem nothing to Forget Me Not, as he just turns around and walks to the piano.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Next time you see a wounded snake, don't save it no more.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Crush it to pieces.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: Smear its tongue with the ashes of despair.

items.speaker: Forget Me Not
items.text: People are coming here. This time, they are our companions.

items.speaker: X
items.text: Wow. What is that man going to do? What a terrible arcanum fluctuation ...! If I knew it I wouldn't have come in!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ahh hah? Are you having a quarrel? Looks like it poured at a bad time?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Sonetto ... Regulus ...?

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: You're not hurt! That's great!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: I am sorry. You protected me when the wall fell ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: But I could not save you ... and even let you confront the Manus alone. ... I am sorry ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Your hands are trembling, Sonetto ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Calm down. You did nothing wrong.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: We are together now, aren't we? There are more challenges for us to take.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: It's not the time to catch up.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: ... You ... you are right.

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: We are late, but not too late ...

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: Timekeeper, I-I am so glad that you are safe and sound!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: What comes next is the final battle!

items.speaker: Sonetto
items.text: This time, please let me protect you.
TO BE CONTINUED…
